author: agent
text:
UNREFERENCED. Found 2026-08-22 while auditing every consumer of a meta entry's text. Nothing in this repository imports agentmap: no CLI command, no MCP tool, no test, no other module, and the map's own edge graph gives scope() zero callers. 165 lines, reachable only by someone who opens the file.

IT IS NOT ABANDONED JUNK, which is why this is a note and not a deletion. The design in its docstring - path confidence as the product of edge confidences, impact x confidence x centrality ranking, a hard token budget that states what fraction of impact mass was shown, "never pretend coverage" - is the design memway actually adopted. It just got implemented elsewhere, incrementally, without anyone coming back to this file:

  - ranked / bounded / REPORTED landed in payload.rank_bound_report
    (0.58.0), including the "a list that quietly stops is a sampled
    list" rule this docstring states first.
  - path confidence and the guessed-edge census landed in
    before_edit's grounding block and LOW_CONFIDENCE.
  - the "cards" idea became the viz/console coordinate card.

So this is superseded scaffolding, and the honest options are to delete it or to wire it up. What it must NOT do is sit here looking like a supported surface.

TWO DEFECTS INSIDE IT, recorded because they decide nothing while it is dead and would matter the moment it were wired up:

  _card reads meta.read_all(cid) RAW and takes notes[-1] - file order,
  no for_display. A re-stamp carries no text, so card["why"] would come
  back EMPTY on any coordinate whose notes channel was re-stamped, and a
  superseded note would be presented as current. The same second-copy
  bug found and fixed in cmd_show and in before_edit's inherited-
  knowledge loop the same day; this is the third site, still broken
  because nothing calls it.

  card["why_stale"] can never be set. It reads latest.get("stale"), but
  MetaStore.read only applies stale flags when it is given a
  current_hash, and this call passes none. A flag with no path to True.

Deleting is a maintainer call (CODEOWNERS-adjacent), so it is written down rather than done.
